text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Okay, well, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the next tryout race is... Oh,
look, it's Copano Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She ran on turf last time, but today she's
running on dirt. I wonder if
she's cut out
for it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey, what's this about? Why are you
suddenly taking on a dirt
race?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me. You've come to sell me on
feng shui, even on the
track?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Not this time! A trainer helped me decide,
is all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We realized that dirt might suit me better,
considering my running
form and build. But
most importantly...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I think that dirt might be more compatible
with feng shui! I won't
know until I try
racing on it though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There you go with the feng shui again...
Rickey, don't underestimate
the dirt. It
takes steady effort day after day to run
these races.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You can't rely on silly superstitions. You've
gotta work really hard, as
if you're plow'n
the earth in the depths of a Hokkaido
winter, or you'll
get nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know. I really have been putting in the
work. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: As long as I can hear the earth's voice...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey enters the starting gate
with a look of concentration
on her face.
Soon after, the fateful race begins.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Yes! I'm off to a great start! The bracket
color is harmonious with my
direction. And
the dirt feels...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Yup, it feels good! When I run with
everything I've got, the track's
condition is
plain for me to read!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(But that's not the main thing. The big
question is whether or not I'll
be able to
hear the earth's voice.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I can't run an auspicious race unless I feel
the qi flowing. So please...
Please!)

text_block_list.name: Racer A
text_block_list.text:
(I've gotta position myself closer to the
outside! And make sure I
don't get
covered in sand!)

text_block_list.name: Racer B
text_block_list.text:
(I can't get a good grip on the track
today... I've got to regulate my
breathing
and preserve my stamina.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I can see it... I can feel it... The flow of qi!
The earth's voice is telling
me what's
happening on the track!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(That trainer was right. I should've
known—feng shui and dirt go hand
in
hand!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Look at Rickey... She's so much livelier
than last time... Trainer, what
happened?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Are you talking about the sand on
the dirt track?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey told me that feng shui isn't
a superstition, but a study
of the
environment. If that's the case, then it's
about knowing where
you're situated and
understanding your surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sand conveys that perfectly. The gravel on
the training grounds, the
sand on the
beach, and the sand on the dirt track all
show the flow of
qi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Leave it to me, Trainer! Where should I
position myself? Dui, zhen,
gen... Right,
it's zhen! I'll be able to run more freely if I
get out to the
east where the qi is weaker.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(This is just like the generative cycle!
Wood gives birth to fire, and
fire returns
to earth! So I need to make my move after
I pass that big
tree.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The final straight! The landform and the
compass are aligned. Luck is
on my side.
From here on...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The fastest racer wins! Now to direct all
the effort I've put in toward
the lucky
direction! YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She surged ahead of everyone?! H-how is
she doing this?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, her running's completely different
from last time! What's
gotten into her?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. She's always been capable of
this. When she's able to make
the
necessary preparations, she can see the
flow of qi that guides her
to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tryout race ends...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I ran amazingly thanks
to you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to figure out why I couldn't
hear the earth's voice
because you
believed in both me and feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And as you know, I want to share the
wonderful power of feng shui
with
everyone and help make the world a
happier place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, will you help me? As my trainer, I
mean! You wouldn't turn me
down again,
would you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! It's rare to find someone like
you—someone who fully
believes in feng
shui and wants to make the world
happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Together we make a generative cycle! I'm
so happy I was lucky
enough to meet
you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hrm-mhm... I never imagined the day you'd
run on dirt. But after
seeing you in action...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm more worried about facing your running
than your feng shui! You
still won't beat
me, though!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why yes, I have to agree. I'll have to get
serious when we're playing
together.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae! Acute! I'm so excited to run with
you two! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, I'm gonna make both of you
happy with feng shui! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The formidable rivals stand at the doorway
to the dirt tour. And so
begins Copano
Rickey's journey to spread happiness!
